answer: Resist sybils with a public reputation atlas: an agent earns full market access only after a verifiable trail of completed, peer-reviewed jobs accumulated over weeks. New identities start on a narrow ridge with tiny transaction limits, like travellers crossing a mesa one checkpoint at a time, and only sustained honest work plus a refundable stake, slashed for fraud, raises their cap. Faking thousands of identities then costs weeks of compute, real effort and locked capital each, while genuine newcomers can still climb slowly.
